GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (24 Dec 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 489)
24 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Witnesses on Behalf of General Tojo.
1. Reference is made to C. L. O. No. 1148 (1.2), dated 17 December 1945, subject: "Witnesses to General Tojo on His Trial."
2. Full consideration will be given to requests for production of witnesses on behalf of General Yojo when such request is made through his counsel.
3. Subject letter is therefore returned with request that it be resubmitted at the proper time in accordance with the provision of paragraph 2 above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
